fallacy_checks.Simpson_paradox: Overall vs H90-unflagged performance reported separately; no pooling across cohorts; difference in significance is not an interaction test.
fallacy_checks.ecological_fallacy: Distinct patients and repeated event counts explicitly separated; no individual treatment conclusion from group figures.
fallacy_checks.Berkson_selection: All results conditional on adult culture-order cohort; no general-population claim.
fallacy_checks.collider_bias: H90-unflagged conditional prediction is not etiologic estimation; H90 retained identically.
fallacy_checks.base_rate_neglect: Events, positive events, AP, known nonpositive and unknown alert counts reported.
fallacy_checks.regression_to_mean: No post-hoc winner selected from evaluation outcomes; paired within-cohort comparisons; no automatic main-model change.
fallacy_checks.survivorship_missingness: Performance based on known outcomes only, while unknown events consume clinical quota; prior unknown sensitivity remains relevant.
fallacy_checks.look_elsewhere: All two variants, four cohorts, three budgets and two performance populations retained; pointwise CIs unadjusted.
fallacy_checks.forking_paths: Plan frozen before these two fits; prior exploratory selection and prior access to evaluation cohorts disclosed.
fallacy_checks.correlation_causation: Drop-group predictive differences do not demonstrate causality, mechanism, clinical irrelevance or equivalent models.
fallacy_checks.reverse_causality: T0 available data used as frozen source; lab/specimen/history timing limitations inherited; no earlier-treatment claim.

limitations: conditional fixed-model intervals exclude training/model-selection uncertainty
